verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general Paystack API for managing transactions and retrieving transaction data, plus support for recurring payments. Nothing documents webhooks for payment-failure events, automated or API-driven payment retries, or dunning outreach. The 'failed request' diagnostics cover API request errors, not failed customer payments, so they don't transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
